chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Blessed is the person who kept in mind the next life, acted so as to be able to render account, remained content with what sufficed him and remained pleased with Allāh.

key_terms.الْمَعَادَ: The Next Life / The Return (to God)

ai.seo_question: What are the four qualities that make a person blessed according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) outlines the spiritual prerequisites for salvation, linking eschatological mindfulness (Ma'ad) with ethical contentment (Qana'ah). This triad of remembering the Hereafter, preparing for accountability, and finding satisfaction in divine decree reflects the Shia emphasis on balancing inner spiritual states with outward righteous action to attain divine pleasure (Rida).

en.sayed-ali-raza: 44. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Blessed is the person who kept in mind the next life, acted so as to be able to render account, remained content with what sufficed him and remained pleased with Allāh.
